create.name: Guru Singh
create.bio:
Guru Singh is a Kundalini yoga teacher, author and musician who has been teaching for more than fifty years. He grew up in a household steeped in yoga, music and art, in a family whose connection to yoga and mysticism reaches back to 1916, and he describes himself as a third-generation yogi. With his wife, Guruperkarma Kaur, he founded Kundalini University, which now carries his teaching through online classes, teacher trainings and recorded courses.

He calls his approach practical spirituality: kriyas, breathwork, mantra and meditation explained in plain language, often with a scientific turn, and aimed at everyday clarity, intuition and steadiness rather than escape. His sessions mix teaching with music, and his recorded mantras, including two albums made with the singer Seal, are widely streamed. He has written around ten books of essays, prayers and reflections, among them Buried Treasures, about the years after a near-death experience that changed his direction, and A Year of Prayer. Members of Kundalini University practise with him live twice a week, and his YouTube channel has free classes and talks on Kundalini, intuition and the mind.

books.title: Buried Treasures: The Journey from Where You Are to Who You Are
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: A memoir of three years in his early adult life after a near-death experience, and the inner changes that set him on the yogic path.

books.title: 21st Century Prophets: The Sage Within
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: Reflections on turning inward to find one's own inner sage and personal truth instead of looking for it in outside authorities.

books.title: Infinite Zero: Everything Comes from Nothing
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: A collection of short essays offering courage and perspective for fast-changing times, built around the idea of meeting each moment fresh.

books.title: Levity: Finding Magic in a World of Logic
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: Parables and prayer-like chapters that look at the complexity of modern life with a lighter, more spacious eye.

books.title: A Year of Prayer: 365 Inspirational Days
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: A daily book of short inspirational passages, one for each day of the year, drawn from his morning prayers.

books.title: 108 Ways to Great Days: A Journey Through Journaling
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: A guided journal of 108 steps, each a short prompt for reflection aimed at ease and contentment.

books.title: Angels Gather Here: Nine Angelic Aspects of Human Life on Planet Earth
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: Mantric messages built around nine angelic qualities, for readers who want to invite more grace into daily life.

books.title: Spiritual Pavement Vol. 1: Simple Wisdom for the Enlightened Road
books.author: Guru Singh
books.description: Short pieces of everyday wisdom, collected from his teaching, for those walking a spiritual path in ordinary life.

courses.title: Kundalini University Membership
courses.description: Live online Kundalini practice twice a week, on Tuesday and Sunday mornings, with Guru Singh and senior teachers, plus a members' community. Cancel any time.
courses.price: $29.99 / month or $299.99 / year (monthly rises to $49.99 on 16 November)

courses.title: Advancing Intuition (recorded immersion)
courses.description: A four-hour recorded immersion on developing intuitive perception through breath, sound and movement, with lifetime access.

courses.title: Relational Intelligence
courses.description: Five hours of on-demand teaching, practice and Q&A on relationship, starting with the relationship to oneself, drawing on his long marriage and practice.

courses.title: Kundalini Essentials: Purpose
courses.description: A five-day guided programme of practice and reflection to uncover a sense of purpose, with lifetime access.

free_resources.title: Kundalini at Home
free_resources.description: Five free practices with Guru Singh, sent by email: a kriya, yoga nidra, a meditation, a mantra and a wisdom talk, from about ten to forty minutes each.
